job.title: Bid Writer / Bid Manager
job.description:
• ASX Listed Business
  • $140 - $160k + super + bonus 
  • Sydney CBD 
An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced Bid Writer who is looking to take the next step.  Join a leading ASX-listed Australian business.

This is a key role within the organisation, responsible for managing the end-to-end bid process across a range of high-value and strategically important opportunities.

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, highly organised and confident bringing together multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling, winning submissions.

Experience within the energy sector would be highly regarded,
particularly someone who has worked across complex tenders, infrastructure, resources or other highly regulated environments.

The Opportunity
As the Bid Manager, you will take ownership of the bid lifecycle from opportunity through to submission and handover.
Working closely with Sales, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal and subject matter experts, you will develop high-quality proposals that clearly demonstrate the organisation's capability and value proposition.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing end-to-end bid and tender processes
  • Developing bid strategies, response plans and submission timelines
  • Reviewing and analysing RFPs, tenders and procurement documentation
  • Coordinating internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Developing compelling written responses and proposal content
  • Managing bid governance, compliance and quality assurance
  • Preparing executive-level presentations and supporting materials
  • Managing multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously
  • Working closely with commercial and operational teams to ensure responses are accurate, competitive and commercially sound
  • Conducting post-bid reviews and continually improving the bid process
About You
You'll be an experienced Bid Writer, Bid Manager, Proposal Manager or Tender Manager who enjoys working in a fast-paced, commercially focused environment.

You'll bring:
  • Proven experience managing complex bids, tenders or proposals from start to finish
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong project and stakeholder management capability
  • The ability to influence and coordinate senior stakeholders
  • Exceptional attention to detail and an ability to work to tight deadlines
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to understand complex business requirements
  • Confidence working across multiple functions and competing priorities
Energy sector experience would be highly desirable, along with experience across infrastructure, resources, logistics, transport, engineering or other complex B2B environments.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone with energy, drive and a genuine desire to win - someone who can take ownership, bring people together and elevate the quality of every submission.

The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to join a major Australian organisation with significant scale, complexity and growth opportunities.

You'll have the opportunity to work on high-value, strategically important bids and have genuine visibility across the broader business.

If you're an accomplished Bid Manager looking for a role where your work directly contributes to winning significant new business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Naomi at Pathfinder Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Account Manager | MSP
job.description:
Pathfinder Recruitment are excited to bring to market a great opportunity for an Account Manager to join a Melbourne based managed services provider (MSP). Working across a broad client base of SMBs in Melbourne, you will facilitate growth and ultimately the continued success of the business. You will be joining a great team with a supportive work culture, as well and learning and development initiatives. This role will be based primarily on-site. 
  
About you 
Ideally you have 3+ years experience in Account Management and a good technical understanding of IT products and services. Expertise in the Microsoft stack will be advantageous. You should be able to work autonomously as well as part of a team. Building trust with key stakeholders and maintaining client relationships will be critical to your success. Having a good track record of reaching KPIs as well as previous MSP experience is desired. 
   
Key skills 
  
  • 3+ years experience as an Account Manager   
  • Previous experience working in an MSP environment  
  • Strong understanding of IT products and services, particularly Microsoft and cloud services 
  • Ability to collaborate and align strategy, goals and objectives 
  • Manage internal and external stakeholders 
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills 
  • Goal driven, able to take initiative as well as work as part of a team 
  
Key qualifications 
  • Must be Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident to apply 
  • NSW Drivers licence and own car required 
  
Ready to chat? 
Please Apply and we will be in touch with everything you need to know. Looking forward to hearing from you.

job.title: Cyber Security Lead
job.description:
Cyber Security & IT Lead 

We’re looking for an experienced Cyber Security Lead to take ownership of cyber security and IT operations across a growing national brand with big plans!!
Reporting directly to the CTO, this is a hands-on role with genuine influence and visibility across the business. You’ll own the security space, help shape our IT environment, and play a key role in how we safely adopt AI.
What you’ll be doing
  • Own and mature the cyber security program, aligned to Essential Eight and ISO 27001 principles.
  • Manage our Microsoft security stack across Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview and Conditional Access.
  • Own identity, access, incident response and security awareness.
  • Lead security reporting, risk management and relationships with external security partners.
  • Provide hands-on IT leadership across Microsoft 365, endpoints, networks and collaboration tools.
  • Support technology migrations and consolidation across both businesses.
  • Help establish safe and effective AI usage and security practices.
What we’re looking for
  • 5+ years’ experience in a hands-on security or security-focused IT role.
  • Strong Microsoft 365 security and Essential Eight knowledge.
  • Solid understanding of identity, MFA, privileged access and least privilege.
  • A pragmatic, risk-based approach — focused on real security, not compliance theatre.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Someone who actively uses AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot to work smarter.
Why join us?
  • Direct access to the CTO and executive team.
  • Genuine ownership of cyber security across a growing Australian brand.
  • Modern Microsoft-first technology environment.
  • An AI-forward culture with the tools and freedom to innovate.
  • Hybrid working and a supportive team.
If you’re looking for a role where you can own security, influence technology decisions and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior HR Systems Consultant
job.description:
• $850-$1000 per day 
  • 6 month contract
  • Hybrid role / Redfern Location 
About the role
This Global client  is currently undertaking a significant HRIS transformation, and we're looking for an experienced Senior HR Systems Consultant to join the People & Culture team on a 6-month contract.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an HR Systems professional who enjoys taking systems from design and configuration through testing, implementation and go-live.

You'll work closely with People & Culture, Technology and key business stakeholders to ensure the new HR platform delivers a great experience for employees and managers, while integrating effectively with the wider technology environment.

What you'll be doing
  • Configure and build HR system solutions from agreed designs
  • Lead UAT, including test planning, scripts, test data, defect management and business sign-off
  • Assess the impact of system and process changes across payroll, finance, reporting and other connected systems
  • Coordinate integration and regression testing
  • Develop and deliver stakeholder communications, training and change activities
  • Support go-live, hypercare and continuous improvement
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual workarounds
  • Support the decommissioning of the existing HR platform and secure retention of employee data
  • Partner with P&C, Technology and business stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes
About you
You'll have:
  • 5+ years' experience implementing, configuring or supporting HR/People systems
  • Strong hands-on HRIS configuration and implementation experience
  • Proven experience with UAT, testing and defect management
  • Experience taking systems through go-live and stabilisation
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle
  • Experience working with system integrations and downstream data flows
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • The ability to influence and collaborate across a matrix environment
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach and strong attention to detail
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, globally distributed organisation
Why join?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in a significant HR technology transformation, working across People & Culture, Technology and the wider business.

You'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how employees and people leaders interact with the people systems.

6-month contract | Full-time | Hybrid

job.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
job.description:
• $120k + super
  • 1 day per week Sydney CBD
  • A varied role where you'll be an integral part of a collaborative team.
We're looking for an experienced Executive Assistant & Office Manager who enjoys variety, takes pride in keeping things organised and loves being part of a busy, supportive team.

This is a broad role combining executive support, office coordination, events and administration. You'll work closely with the CEO, Chair and wider team, providing essential support across the business and helping keep everything running smoothly.

The role is primarily working from home, with one day per week in the Sydney CBD office, offering the flexibility of remote working while still providing regular face-to-face time with the team.

What you'll be doing
  • Providing administrative and executive support to the CEO and Chair
  • Managing calendars, meetings and meeting logistics
  • Coordinating domestic and international travel
  • Supporting events and strategy days
  • Preparing reports, documents and meeting papers
  • Taking and distributing meeting minutes
  • Coordinating communications on behalf of the CEO and wider team
  • Supporting expenses, accounts payable, payroll and credit card reconciliations
  • Coordinating office requirements across multiple locations
  • Maintaining the asset register and assisting with annual insurance renewals
  • Supporting HR administration and wider team initiatives
  • Liaising with senior stakeholders and external contacts
  • Assisting the team with ad hoc projects and priorities
About you

You'll be an experienced EA, Office Manager, Team Assistant or Business Support professional who enjoys a varied role and working collaboratively with others.
You'll bring:
  • Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Experience supporting senior executives
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • A proactive, hands-on approach
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Confidence dealing with senior stakeholders
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills
  • A positive, professional and personable approach
  • A genuine team-first mindset
  • The ability to work independently while remaining closely connected to the wider team
Why apply?
  • $120,000 + super
  • Primarily WFH — only 1 day per week in Sydney CBD
  • A genuinely varied EA & Office Management role
  • Work closely with senior leaders and a collaborative team
  • A role with autonomy, variety and responsibility
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the wider team
If you're an experienced EA or Office Manager looking for a varied, flexible role within a genuinely collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.
